note.note:
I’m ready to generate the SOAP note, but I need the actual content.

Please provide:
- The full transcript of the doctor–patient encounter.
- The Differential Diagnosis (DDx) in JSON format.

What I will deliver after receiving them:
- A structured SOAP Clinical Note with the exact headings and bullet-point formatting you specified.
- Subjective: presenting complaint details (onset, duration, progression), past medical history, medications, allergies, social history.
- Objective: relevant physical findings, any documented vitals or exam details (if present in the transcript).
- Assessment & Plan: organized by issue(s) with:
  - Issue name (one per section)
  - Likely diagnosis
  - Differential diagnoses from the DDx that are consistent with the transcript (marking “conflict noted” if there is any conflict between transcript and DDx)
  - Investigations planned (if applicable)
  - Treatments planned (if applicable)
  - Referrals (if applicable)
- Quality checks: note any missing but clinically expected elements (e.g., allergies, meds reconciliation), any internal conflicts between transcript and DDx (mark “conflict noted”), and a brief comment on transcript quality if needed.

Notes on how I will handle content:
- I will not introduce any facts not present in the transcript or DDx (no invented vitals, labs, or other data).
- If a medication is mentioned without dose/route/frequency, I will record the medication name and append “dose/route/frequency not documented.”
- If there is conflicting information between the transcript and the DDx, I will include both and label it “conflict noted.”
- I will use American English, concise professional tone, and present findings in short, factual bullets.
